tests.command: npm ci --include=dev && npm test && npm prune --omit=dev

runtime_probe.name: personalization_scheduling_190
runtime_probe.execution: Real configured model with synthetic messages only; no scheduled action, external tool or Telegram chat message is executed by the probe.

recovery.scope: Each chat independently; explicit historical instructions only, checked against the author and quoted source.

personalization: Durable per-chat and per-participant preferences with chat-language precedence.
Explicit preferred names override repeated reply-bound observed aliases and Telegram names; own correction or reset is respected.
Individual recent style examples are separated by author and blended for group dialogue without changing default personality.
A central outgoing-text transform covers messages, edits, polls, buttons and media captions. One-off translation exceptions do not change saved policy.
Existing explicit chat and self preferences are recovered from the stored history; quoted and forwarded requests have no configuration authority.
scheduling: Natural language can resolve a deferred action from recent chat context into an immutable instruction and concrete local time.
Explicit requests are saved directly. Tentative proposals require a visible confirmation bound to their author, topic, source and expiry.
Timezone and optional local-clock cross-check reject mismatched UTC offsets. Invalid dates do not discard a valid preference update in the same request.
Durable reminder and agent-task paths use deduplication; real work is created at the due time with a fresh execution deadline.
Completion reflects actual task state and delivery of all message chunks. A failed or ambiguous reminder delivery needs attention.
related: Semantic authorization removes dependence on a single Ukrainian trigger word while retaining source and actor checks.
A participant cannot cancel another participant's legacy reminder through text actions or /cancel.
Pause, revision changes, forgetting and erasure block or remove derived schedules and preferences.
Translation preparation errors stop before Telegram network submission; safe preparation retries do not invent delivery success.
Conversation continuation recognizes a pending schedule confirmation without requiring a repeated bot name.

limits: The production model probe validates planning and outgoing translation on synthetic inputs. Real user-chat due-time delivery is covered by regression tests, not by a new unsolicited live test message.
Historical past-due tasks are not silently recreated. New ambiguous requests require clarification or confirmation.
Recovery scans the latest 150 stored user messages and applies up to 12 supported explicit preference declarations per chat.
The new scheduling path supports one-time dates within 366 days. A tentative proposal expires after 30 minutes.
